duties_responsibilities: Implement product features that are secure, scalable, robust, and easy to maintain.
Handle terabytes of data and multiple data sources.
Provide bug fixes and ensure features work well at cloud scale.
Work with minimal supervision within self-organizing Agile teams.
required_qualifications: 10+ years of healthcare product/application development experience.
Experience in Industrialization Algorithms, Python, AWS, Spark, and ML.
Experience in handling terabytes of data.
preferred_qualifications: Experience with tools such as JIRA, Bitbucket, Confluence.
Understanding of AWS Security, API Gateway.
